Our Vision in Morocco

A local hub for a cleaner, brighter tomorrow.

The Zenata Casablanca showroom is being planned as a place to experience Winston Energy’s solutions, meet our team and partners, explore applications, and discuss practical energy and mobility projects.

Our ambition is to combine a welcoming customer-facing space with technical consultation and workshop capabilities — creating a stronger local presence for customers in Morocco and the wider African market.

Experience clean-energy and mobility solutions first-hand
Meet customers, business partners and project stakeholders
Explore innovative battery, storage and electric-mobility technologies
Strengthen local technical support and long-term cooperation

A Visible Local Presence

Powering Everything Electric.

The planned exterior branding brings the Winston Energy identity to the heart of the site, creating a clear landmark for visitors and partners.

A large-format LED display is being considered for the building facade, featuring the Winston Energy logo and the brand line “Powering Everything Electric.”

  • ✓A clear and consistent Winston Energy brand experience

Strategic Location

Rooted in Morocco. Connected to opportunity.

Planned for Zenata, Casablanca, the showroom is intended to bring Winston Energy closer to customers, business partners and project opportunities in Morocco.

It is envisioned as a local meeting point for clean energy, storage and electric mobility — with a wider outlook toward regional cooperation across Africa.
